added.summary: The engine's game icon set: `<Icon name>` draws 113 game icons before the Lucide fallback (which keeps only the names the set lacks, such as back, close, chevrons and gear). Twenty hero icons are drawn as multi-tone stickers in the pack's colours (coin, gem, star, heart, shield, energy, ammo, lock, key, chest, gift, crown, potion, ticket, xp, alert, new, rarity, trophy, hourglass); the rest are filled game-icons.net silhouettes in the icon's ink, covering stats, navigation, settings, social, shop, rewards and status effects. The names are listed in templates/styles/shared/icons/README.md; a game's own icons still win by name.

The icon set's tones: icon-gold, icon-red, icon-blue, icon-green, icon-purple, icon-orange, icon-steel, icon-wood, icon-glass, and the sticker's icon-outline, icon-shadow, icon-shade, icon-gloss and icon-mark, the same in both schemes; a pack's theme restyles every toned icon through them. The scifi, fantasy and cartoon packs set their own.

The Credits screen lists the engine's credits (the authors of the icon set's game-icons.net icons, CC BY 3.0) after the game's sections; `engineCredits` (@origingame/engine/ui/screens/engine-credits.ts) holds them for a game that rolls its own.
